description: [Wicked Registry] Step 2 of getting a free API key. Submit the wallet, the timestamp and YOUR signature over the message from registry_onboarding_message(action=api_key). The key (wr_...) is returned once - store it and pass it as api_key to registry_search_tools / registry_tool_detail. Up to 3 active keys per wallet; past the daily cap calls fall back to x402.

timestamp.description: The timestamp returned with the message.
